title: Phi's Additions
description: Phi's Additions is a java mod for 1.20.1 forge that adds a variety of different things such as dimensions, blocks, etc.
body:
# Phi's Additions

## What does this mod add?
_Phi's Additions gives you a variety of new blocks, mobs, dimensions, and more!_
## What are some of the additions?
_Some can be referred as the..._

# Nether Smelter
_A smelter / furnace that is used to cook nether items quicker._

# Cheesy Bread
_A new food item, which can be created with 3 steps._

![How to make your bread into slices.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7c8bc777f9bc91add16cb8ffb604d48f0b1f809.webp)

![How to make cheese.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b04dc80338b1ddeb179c25b7882bf4d2e04d7a5.webp)

![How to make cheesy bread.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/796052dc558859d3aec54fa979ac5e87f6b55654.webp)

# Frigid Nether
A new dimension, based around it's frozen apperance and snowy atmosphere.
